head: 0a7476494f67414d83f5bae40876ae18be04b35d
label: Actual pre-dispatch ordinary form: Real time default, 12:1, Standard, Dry; isolated stub/test providers
dom:
- main:
  - paragraph:
    - button "← Main menu"
  - heading "New game" [level=1]
  - form "New game":
    - group "Scenario":
      - generic: Scenario
      - radio "Hold the Bridge" [checked]
      - generic: Hold the Bridge
      - paragraph: Blue holds a river crossing on the high road against a Red advance from the north. Blue wins by keeping the objective for 50 minutes; Red wins by taking it, or by breaking the defence.
      - paragraph: "Sides: Blue and Red. About 50 minutes of battle, 4 minutes at this rate."
    - group "Your side":
      - generic: Your side
      - paragraph: Blue
      - paragraph: A computer opponent plays the other side.
    - group "How the game is played":
      - generic: How the game is played
      - radio "Real time" [checked]
      - generic: Real time
      - radio "Turns, umpire decides"
      - generic: Turns, umpire decides
      - status: The clock runs at the rate you choose; orders ride by courier while the battle goes on.
    - group "Clock rate":
      - generic: Clock rate
      - radio "1:1"
      - text: 1:1
      - radio "4:1"
      - text: 4:1
      - radio "12:1" [checked]
      - text: 12:1
      - radio "Custom"
      - text: Custom
      - status: 12:1 means one hour of battle passes in five minutes.
    - group "How strictly the umpire follows the rules":
      - generic: How strictly the umpire follows the rules
      - radio "Rigid"
      - generic: Rigid
      - radio "Standard" [checked]
      - generic: Standard
      - radio "Free"
      - generic: Free
      - status: The tables decide, and where the rules are silent the umpire may nudge a result by up to a quarter either way.
    - group "Umpire's manner":
      - generic: Umpire's manner
      - radio "Dry staff officer" [checked]
      - generic: Dry staff officer
      - radio "Pedantic umpire"
      - generic: Pedantic umpire
      - radio "Dramatic correspondent"
      - generic: Dramatic correspondent
      - status: Terse and matter-of-fact reports and rulings, as from a seasoned staff officer.
      - paragraph: The manner changes only how the umpire writes, never what happens.
    - button "Start"
    - button "Back"
  - heading "Your games" [level=2]
  - list:
    - listitem: No games yet.
